name: strata-v100-sustained-1024
description: Sustained 1024-token answers at 64k and 262k on the resident 4x V100-32G IQ3_S server, to separate strict decode/TPOT from the 128-token matrix.

estimate.basis: 3 x (prefill + 1024 tokens) at 64k and 262k; about 14 s of decode per request at 72 tok/s

caveats: NEW DEFINITION, first run 2026-10-27. The 262k cell is prefill-dominated; report strict decode/TPOT separately from aggregate.
3 requests per slot at C1; the engine's predicted_ms is the strict decode window, the client total includes TTFT.
The 262k cell needs the resident 4x server; on fewer cards the pack does not fit the same way.
